notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
We have pushed an update that now fixes the issues on PC where the game would freeze when starting a new game.

We hope you enjoy the game!

~The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Mac users rejoice!
notes.content:
[h1]We've just patched IWO: Bloodbath in the Bonins![/h1]

[b]This patch address the issue that prevented the game from launching by Mac users since the latest update.[/b]

Apologies for the delay in getting this out to everyone!  We really hope you enjoy the struggle for control of IWO!

Thanks for supporting our games and please keep the feedback coming! 

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: IWO Patch 2!
notes.content:
We've just released our second update for IWO.  

This update resolves issues with the End Phase button from being unselectable and fixes an issue with Saved games as well as an array of minor bug fixes.

If anyone is experiencing any other problems with IWO, please let us know!

~ The HexWar Games Team
